notes.title: Click Cricket World Cup 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Click Cricket now features all 20 countries competing in the 2024 T20 World Cup. An updated tournament format features 4 competing groups leading to a knockout phase and final.

Full update notes:-

[list]
[*]Team count increased to 20 including and now includes Namibia, Oman, Papua New Guinea, Canada and Uganda.
[*]Updated rankings based on 2024 positions.
[*]Day/Night matches now included.
[*]Current match time shown during games with teams batting later into the night facing varying conditions.
[*]Group phase now expanded to 4 groups of 5 teams (with top 2 qualifying for the knockout stages).
[*]New backgrounds for matches and tournament screens.
[*]Improvements to AI team selection including increased awareness of player form.
[*]Various small UI enhancements
[/list]
